from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import yfinance as yf
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.ml import PipelineModel

ET = ZoneInfo("America/New_York")

STORAGE_ACCOUNT = "stnvdaanna2026"

HISTORICAL_GOLD_PATH = (
    f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "tweets_stock/historical/"
)

MODEL_PATH = (
    f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "models/nvda_volume_rf/"
)

PREDICTION_ROOT = (
    f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "prediction/streaming/"
)

print("Historical Gold:", HISTORICAL_GOLD_PATH)
print("Model:", MODEL_PATH)
print("Prediction:", PREDICTION_ROOT)

BACKFILL_DATE = "2026-09-15"

start_date = BACKFILL_DATE
end_date = (
    datetime.strptime(BACKFILL_DATE, "%Y-%m-%d")
    + timedelta(days=1)
).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

nvda = yf.download(
    "NVDA",
    start=start_date,
    end=end_date,
    auto_adjust=False,
    progress=False
)

print(nvda)

historical_gold_df = spark.read.parquet(
    HISTORICAL_GOLD_PATH
)

print("Historical rows:", historical_gold_df.count())

historical_gold_df.select(
    "prediction_session_date",
    "next_trading_date",
    "next_available_volume"
).orderBy(
    F.col("prediction_session_date").desc()
).show(30, truncate=False)

(
    historical_gold_df
    .groupBy(
        "prediction_session_date",
        "next_trading_date"
    )
    .agg(
        F.first("next_available_volume").alias("actual_next_volume"),
        F.count("*").alias("tweet_count")
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("prediction_session_date").desc()
    )
    .show(30, truncate=False)

from datetime import date, timedelta

# Pull enough recent market history to resolve outstanding labels.
# yfinance `end` is exclusive, so use tomorrow.
end_date = date.today() + timedelta(days=1)
start_date = date.today() - timedelta(days=30)

print(f"Downloading NVDA: {start_date} -> {end_date} (end exclusive)")

stock_pdf = yf.download(
    "NVDA",
    start=start_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
    end=end_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
    auto_adjust=False,
    progress=False
)

# yfinance may return MultiIndex columns
if hasattr(stock_pdf.columns, "levels"):
    stock_pdf.columns = stock_pdf.columns.get_level_values(0)

stock_pdf = stock_pdf.reset_index()

stock_lookup = {
    row["Date"].strftime("%Y-%m-%d"): int(row["Volume"])
    for _, row in stock_pdf.iterrows()
}

print("Available market dates:")
for market_date, volume in stock_lookup.items():
    print(market_date, f"{volume:,}")

unresolved_sessions_df = (
    historical_gold_df
    .filter(
        F.col("next_available_volume").isNull()
    )
    .select(
        "prediction_session_date",
        "next_trading_date"
    )
    .distinct()
    .orderBy("prediction_session_date")
)

display(unresolved_sessions_df)

from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, DateType, LongType
from datetime import datetime

ground_truth_rows = [
    (
        datetime.strptime(date, "%Y-%m-%d").date(),
        volume
    )
    for date, volume in stock_lookup.items()
]

ground_truth_schema = StructType([
    StructField("market_date", DateType(), False),
    StructField("actual_volume", LongType(), False)
])

ground_truth_df = spark.createDataFrame(
    ground_truth_rows,
    ground_truth_schema
)

display(
    ground_truth_df.orderBy(
        F.col("market_date").desc()
    )

backfillable_sessions_df = (
    unresolved_sessions_df
    .join(
        ground_truth_df,
        unresolved_sessions_df["next_trading_date"]
        == ground_truth_df["market_date"],
        "inner"
    )
    .select(
        "prediction_session_date",
        "next_trading_date",
        "actual_volume"
    )
)

display(backfillable_sessions_df)

backfill_count = backfillable_sessions_df.count()

print("Backfillable sessions:", backfill_count)

if backfill_count == 0:
    print("No completed ground truth is available.")
    print("Historical Gold remains unchanged.")
    print("Model remains unchanged.")
else:
    display(backfillable_sessions_df)

if backfill_count > 0:

    labels_df = (
        backfillable_sessions_df
        .select(
            F.col("next_trading_date"),
            F.col("actual_volume")
                .cast("long")
                .alias("backfilled_volume")
        )
    )

    updated_gold_df = (
        historical_gold_df
        .join(
            labels_df,
            on="next_trading_date",
            how="left"
        )
        .withColumn(
            "next_available_volume",
            F.coalesce(
                F.col("next_available_volume"),
                F.col("backfilled_volume")
            )
        )
        .drop("backfilled_volume")
    )

    print(
        "Remaining unlabeled rows:",
        updated_gold_df
        .filter(
            F.col("next_available_volume").isNull()
        )
        .count()

prediction_archive_df = (
    spark.read
    .option("recursiveFileLookup", "true")
    .parquet(PREDICTION_ROOT)
)

prediction_archive_df.select(
    "prediction_session_date",
    "predicted_next_volume",
    "tweet_count",
    "model_version",
    "prediction_generated_at_utc"
).show(truncate=False)

session_target_df = (
    historical_gold_df
    .select(
        "prediction_session_date",
        "next_trading_date"
    )
    .distinct()
)

prediction_with_target_df = (
    prediction_archive_df.alias("p")
    .join(
        session_target_df.alias("s"),
        on="prediction_session_date",
        how="left"
    )
)

prediction_with_target_df.select(
    "prediction_session_date",
    "next_trading_date",
    "predicted_next_volume",
    "tweet_count"
).show(truncate=False)

evaluated_predictions_df = (
    prediction_with_target_df.alias("p")
    .join(
        ground_truth_df.alias("g"),
        F.col("p.next_trading_date")
        == F.col("g.market_date"),
        "inner"
    )
    .withColumn(
        "absolute_error",
        F.abs(
            F.col("actual_volume")
            - F.col("predicted_next_volume")
        )
    )
    .withColumn(
        "relative_error",
        F.col("absolute_error")
        / F.col("actual_volume")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "prediction_accuracy",
        F.lit(1.0)
        - F.col("relative_error")
    )

evaluated_predictions_df.select(
    "prediction_session_date",
    "next_trading_date",
    F.round(
        "predicted_next_volume", 0
    ).alias("predicted_volume"),
    "actual_volume",
    F.round(
        "absolute_error", 0
    ).alias("absolute_error"),
    F.round(
        "relative_error", 4
    ).alias("relative_error"),
    F.round(
        "prediction_accuracy", 4
    ).alias("prediction_accuracy")
).show(truncate=False)

RETRAIN_THRESHOLD = 0.01

retrain_candidates_df = (
    evaluated_predictions_df
    .filter(
        F.col("relative_error")
        > F.lit(RETRAIN_THRESHOLD)
    )
)

retrain_required = (
    retrain_candidates_df.limit(1).count()
    > 0
)

print(
    "Retrain threshold:",
    f"{RETRAIN_THRESHOLD:.1%}"
)

print(
    "Retrain required:",
    retrain_required

HISTORICAL_GOLD_STAGING_PATH = (
    f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/"
    "tweets_stock/historical_staging/"

if backfill_count > 0:

    print("Writing updated Historical Gold to staging...")

    (
        updated_gold_df
        .write
        .mode("overwrite")
        .parquet(HISTORICAL_GOLD_STAGING_PATH)
    )

    # Verify staging before replacing production
    staged_df = spark.read.parquet(
        HISTORICAL_GOLD_STAGING_PATH
    )

    staged_rows = staged_df.count()

    staged_unlabeled = (
        staged_df
        .filter(F.col("next_available_volume").isNull())
        .count()
    )

    print("Staged rows:", staged_rows)
    print("Remaining unlabeled:", staged_unlabeled)

else:
    print("No Gold update required.")

from pyspark.ml import Pipeline
from pyspark.ml.feature import (
    StringIndexer,
    OneHotEncoder,
    VectorAssembler,
    StandardScaler
)
from pyspark.ml.regression import RandomForestRegressor


NUMERIC_FEATURES = [
    "sentiment_score",
    "interaction_score",
    "favorite_ratio",
    "reply_ratio",
    "followers_count",
    "friends_count",
    "media_count",
    "account_age_days",
    "credibility_score"
]

BOOLEAN_FEATURES = [
    "is_viral",
    "is_blue_verified",
    "is_new_account",
    "is_influencer",
    "is_weekend"
]

LABEL_COL = "next_available_volume"

numTrees = 50
maxDepth = 5
minInstancesPerNode = 5

def build_training_pipeline():

    day_indexer = StringIndexer(
        inputCol="day_of_week",
        outputCol="day_of_week_index",
        handleInvalid="keep"
    )

    day_encoder = OneHotEncoder(
        inputCols=["day_of_week_index"],
        outputCols=["day_of_week_ohe"],
        handleInvalid="keep"
    )

    assembler = VectorAssembler(
        inputCols=(
            NUMERIC_FEATURES
            + BOOLEAN_FEATURES
            + ["day_of_week_ohe"]
        ),
        outputCol="features_raw",
        handleInvalid="keep"
    )

    scaler = StandardScaler(
        inputCol="features_raw",
        outputCol="features",
        withStd=True,
        withMean=False
    )

    rf = RandomForestRegressor(
        featuresCol="features",
        labelCol=LABEL_COL,
        predictionCol="prediction",
        numTrees=50,
        maxDepth=5,
        minInstancesPerNode=5,
        seed=42
    )

    return Pipeline(
        stages=[
            day_indexer,
            day_encoder,
            assembler,
            scaler,
            rf
        ]

if retrain_required:

    print("Retraining triggered.")

    # Use updated Gold if labels were just backfilled
    training_source_df = (
        updated_gold_df
        if backfill_count > 0
        else historical_gold_df
    )

    training_df = (
        training_source_df
        .filter(
            F.col(LABEL_COL).isNotNull()
        )
    )

    training_df = prepare_ml_columns(
        training_df
    )

    training_rows = training_df.count()

    training_sessions = (
        training_df
        .select("prediction_session_date")
        .distinct()
        .count()
    )

    print("Training rows:", training_rows)
    print("Training sessions:", training_sessions)

    pipeline = build_training_pipeline()

    new_model = pipeline.fit(
        training_df
    )

    print("Retraining complete.")

else:

    print(
        "Retraining skipped: "
        "no newly evaluated prediction exceeded threshold."
